inputBoundary: One caller-supplied finite 3G received-signal-strength value expressed in dBm from the study trace; technology selection and raw-field decoding occur before this threshold.
outputBoundary: Classify a 3G trace value as poor only when it is strictly below -91.7 dBm; classify equality and higher values as good.
limitations: This binding does not parse collector records, identify the Android signal field/API, select 3G rows, calibrate devices, impute missing or censored measurements, or verify the external Ofcom basis.
This binding does not calculate time fractions or participant aggregates and does not apply the paper's separate screen-on active-use selection.
The paper later uses a distinct -100 dBm 3G validation threshold; that variant is not substituted for this trace-analysis -91.7 dBm setting.
No measurement quantization, rounding, or tolerance around -91.7 dBm is inferred.
